item.title: [ECG] Nanyang Business School Workshop - Future-Proof Your Career: Sustainability and AI
item.description: What will the world of work look like when you graduate? Two mega challenges — sustainability and artificial intelligence (AI) — are already transforming businesses, industries and the careers of tomorrow. The question is not whether these changes will affect you, but how prepared you will be to embrace them. Join Assistant Dean Goh Kia Hong , a passionate educator and industry leader in sustainability and business education, as he explores how sustainability and AI are reshaping the future of business and creating new opportunities for the next generation of business professionals. Discover why future business leaders need more than traditional business knowledge—and how Nanyang Business School prepares its students with the business fundamentals, sustainability insights, digital capabilities and AI skills to stay relevant and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Come curious. Leave inspired. Discover how you can future-proof your career and be ready to shape the future of business. Event Details: Date: 4 August (Tuesaday) Time: 3.00pm - 4.30pm Venue: ECG LT, College Section, Block D, Level 3 Sign-Up: https://forms.gle/4yTi2VeurGYRTJV98 Sign-ups are on a first-come-first-served basis and the sign-up form will close once all seats are filled. Please email highered@hci.edu.sg if you have signed up and are unable to make it.
